summary: Frontend testing for buyer-specific stats, Today's Tasks, and Capex Head global stats. All 9 features verified and working correctly.

issues: Console warnings about HTML hydration errors - <th>/<td>/<tr> cannot be child of <span>. These are React hydration warnings from the Emergent preview environment but don't affect functionality (pre-existing issue from iteration 13-15).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Buyer stats (My Assigned, Completed, In Progress, Total Purchase Value, Cost Savings) are all buyer-specific using myAssigned filter. Capex Head stats (Total Budget Utilized, Cost Savings) remain global. Today's Tasks shows ALL tasks updated today with color-coded badges.

test_1_buyer_my_assigned_count.description: My Assigned count shows ONLY requests assigned to the logged-in buyer (Vijay). Verified: 6 requests assigned to Vijay, stat card shows '6'. Code uses: allRequests.filter(r => r.assigned_buyer_id === user?.id)

test_2_buyer_total_purchase_value.description: Total Purchase Value is buyer-specific. Verified: ₹99,80,627 shown for Vijay. Code uses: myAssigned.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.final_negotiated_price || 0), 0)

test_3_buyer_cost_savings.description: Cost Savings is buyer-specific (initial - final offer from buyer's assigned requests). Verified: ₹32,06,406 (24.1% saved) shown for Vijay. Code calculates from myAssigned suppliers' initial_price - final_price.

test_4_buyer_in_progress_count.description: In Progress counts only DH-approved but NOT completed requests. Verified: 1 request in progress for Vijay. Code excludes: Pending DH Approval, Rejected by DH, Rejected, Completed statuses.

test_5_buyer_completed_count.description: Completed counts requests with status=Completed or workflow_status=Completed. Verified: 2 completed requests for Vijay. Code uses: myAssigned.filter(r => r.workflow_status === 'Completed' || r.status === 'Completed')

test_6_todays_tasks_no_status_filter.description: Today's Tasks shows ALL tasks updated today including completed and rejected ones. Code filters only by updated_at date matching today, no status exclusion. Section only appears when tasks exist for today.

test_7_todays_tasks_color_coded_badges.description: Today's Tasks has color-coded status badges. Code implements getStatusColor(): emerald for completed, red for rejected, blue for approved, amber for pending, violet for processing.

test_8_capex_head_global_stats.description: Capex Head stats remain global (not buyer-filtered). Verified: Total Budget Utilized=₹1,86,61,610, Cost Savings=₹36,13,908. Code uses analytics?.total_purchase_value and analytics?.cost_avoidance from global analytics API.

test_9_stats_consistency.description: Stats are consistent across page navigation. Buyer stats persist correctly when navigating away and back to dashboard.

code_verification.in_progress_logic: notPending = st !== 'Pending DH Approval' && st !== 'Rejected by DH' && st !== 'Rejected'; notCompleted = ws !== 'Completed' && st !== 'Completed'
code_verification.todays_tasks_filter: todaysTasks = myRequests.filter(r => updated.startsWith(today)) - NO status exclusion
